answer: The terrace anchors each key on one parcel from a fixed pool, and a parcel that hosted a key sits fallow the next epoch, so keeping k clones alive permanently ties up 2k parcels. Each lotus, the attacker's fake identity, must also burn one delta per epoch — delta issued only to occupied parcels — and as free parcels thin out, the capital price of a delta climbs with every extra lotus; nothing splits, lends, or sublets. Break: the terrace minting fresh parcels.
